attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe that the United States must invest in biomedical research to make significant progress in battling diseases such as AIDS, Alzheimers, Diabetes, Parkinsons, and spinal cord injuries.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe that the development of new drugs should be sped up and they should be made available to patients sooner while maintaining essential health and safety standards.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support allowing stem cell research to make important new discoveries.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support expanding prevention and widening access to clinical trials.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support devoting more resources to eliminating disease disparities among racial and ethnic groups.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A top priority for Democrats will be continued investment in research, prevention, care, and treatment for HIV and AIDS.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are deeply committed to the search for a cure for HIV and AIDS.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats continue to support the Ryan White CARE Act.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats continue to support the Housing Opportunities for People with AIDS program.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats continue to support incentives to return Americans with HIV/AIDS to work.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
